description: This file is a React component for a UI dashboard managing AI models, displaying metrics, managing models, and handling various configurations. It includes multiple UI sections, data fetching, state management, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: formatCreatedAt
methods.description: Formats a creation date string into a human-readable date.

methods.name: handleEditClick
methods.description: Sets the selected model to be edited and shows the edit modal.

methods.name: handleEditCancel
methods.description: Closes the edit modal and clears selected model.

methods.name: uploadProps
methods.description: Props configuration for uploading JSON files, handles file selection and upload feedback.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Updates the 'lastRefreshed' state to current timestamp.

methods.name: handleSaveRetrySettings
methods.description: Saves the global or model group retry policies via API call.

methods.name: runHealthCheck
methods.description: Initiates a health check operation, updating loading state and response.
